messages:
Maria: FYI - incoming customer ask from Acme to add Terraform provider + JS SDK snippets for marketplace install. They also need SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning. Putting in intake for triage.

Samir: Do we have any existing terraform module they can reuse? @Kevin? Also need to know if this needs private deployment support.

Kevin: we have an internal tf module for model deployment but not the installer for marketplace. Effort rough guess: 2 devs x 3 weeks to expose resources + docs + e2e. SSO/SCIM adds 1 sprint.

Ashley: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- Terraform provider published to registry with versioned release
- JS SDK example for marketplace onboarding
- SSO (SAML) test flow + SCIM provisioning working end-to-end
- Docs + quickstart + post-install checks
- Rollout plan with canary

Maria: tagging as customer-request. Priority: high if sales says enterprise deal. Can we tag in backlog `integration/terraform`, `sdk/js`, `marketplace`, `customer:acme`?

triage-bot: created issue RW-#5792, labels: integration/terraform, sdk/js, marketplace, customer:acme, prio:high

Samir: Need to scope minimum viable deliverable: Maybe just Terraform provider for creating `redwood_deployment` + a JS snippet to call API using marketplace token. SAML/SCIM can be follow-up if time-boxed.

Kevin: I can prototype tf resource + provider scaffolding. Question: do we need HSM/KMS guidance for private deploys? Acme mentioned 'on-prem option'.

Ashley: good call. For initial launch we only need cloud-hosted tests; add "private-deploy: follow-up" label.

Maria: I'll sync with sales to confirm timeline. Meeting Wed 10am PT. @Samir @Kevin can you both join?

Samir: on calendar.

Kevin: yes.

Maria: next actions: 1) Sales confirm SLA/commit 2) triage-bot creates GH epics + link 3) engineering spike to estimate 4) PM writes brief.

triage-bot: epic RW-epic-312 created and linked to RW-#5792

Ashley: added backlog tags: `area:integrations`, `lane:customer-requests`, `effort:medium` :thinking_face:

Maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
